item.title: Arms, narcotics smuggling module busted in Punjab’s Amritsar, 5 held
item.description: CHANDIGARH: Punjab Police busted a cross-border arms and narcotics smuggling module with the arrest of five persons in Amritsar, said state’s Director General of Police Gaurav Yadav on Monday. item.title: Lok Sabha adjourned till noon amid Opposition sloganeering; MPs demand discussion on India-US trade framework
